comment: Read from src/Shear.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. The Feedback jack is the one input on the module with no clamp: Shear.cpp:149 multiplies the knob by the raw voltage, so 10V there makes the feedback ten times what the knob alone can reach, and the only thing holding the result in is the ±1 clamp on the comb sum. The Skew knob has no printed label. The README calls this a true twelve band IIR comb filter; what the code builds is twelve parallel biquad bandpass filters whose centre frequencies are multiples of the Cutoff, which is a comb by shape rather than by delay line. The send and return path is gated on both jacks being connected (lines 153 and 154), so patching only one of the pair does nothing. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line.
